# Full-size v5 verification regression

This development epoch uses the production mathematical parameters: Picard-Fuchs
genus 2, t-degree 2, bound 3, and common isotropic p=3, m=8, k=3, n=35. Its PoW
difficulty is deliberately developmental. It is not a production admission or a
model difficulty benchmark. No reference solver is included.

Certificates are carried only by the fixed submission package. Keep this fixture
outside the production epoch registry and public paper archive.
